styleLock.direction: american light-luxury upholstered bed commerce, warm cream-and-peach infographic system
styleLock.backgroundSystem: 三套背景轮换且全组统一：无缝奶油影棚墙 #F8F3EC 落地 #E4DFD7、实景轻美式卧室腻子墙 #EFE9E0 配亮面浅色地砖 #E4DFD7、蜜桃信息图场 #FBF5EE 上叠沙色标题带 #EFE0D2 与暖白卡面 #FFFDFA；家具落地面必带真实接触阴影
styleLock.lightingSystem: 大面积柔光自机位左侧进入，亮场 4500-5000K 且不低于 4000K；皮面肌理、滚边、拉线与木料端面一律用侧掠光交代，阴影侧以反光板补光，禁止硬高光、过曝高光斑与矛盾光向
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 亮面浅色瓷砖地 #E4DFD7、哑光暖白板 #F2ECE3、奶油长绒地毯；床上织物只用低饱和灰绿 #8FAEA6、暖白 #FFFDFA 与一枚暖橙 #EFA53C 靠枕，织物不得遮盖床体轮廓
styleLock.typography: 中文现代几何无衬线粗黑展示字 + 字距拉开的拉丁 eyebrow 小字；标题 28-44pt、副标 16-20pt、标签 10-14pt，所有画面文案一律以 「」 内占位符渲染，禁止照搬源图原文案
styleLock.iconSystem: 单一线宽细线图标，图标内嵌一块暖橙实心填充 #EFA53C；配套元素仅用丝带序号标签、胶囊标签、1px 细线分割与材料屏角上的超大描边空心汉字；禁止证书徽章、奖牌、二维码、会员与店铺标识
styleLock.presentationRules: 首屏、主图、场景与收口共用同一 3/4 锚定机位与同一床头弧线朝向以保证同一件产品读感；全组显式声明机位与占比；全景镜头不超过全组 40%；含至少一个俯视与一个仰视；皮面、滚边、缝线特写必须侧掠光；软包分格、封边滚条、床体厚度与皮面光泽在任何镜头里都不得改写
noDrift: no brand marks, QR codes, membership or store badges
no invented certifications, measurements, material origins, foam grades, spring counts, load ratings or year figures
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent american light-luxury upholstered-bed ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream base #F8F3EC, peach card field #FAEADC and sand band #EFE0D2, charcoal ink #33302C for all text, warm amber #EFA53C as the only accent and muted sage #8FAEA6 as the single soft secondary in bedding; warm tone, 4500-5000K on bright screens and never below 4000K; background system alternates a seamless cream studio wall #F8F3EC meeting a pale matte floor #E4DFD7, a real light-American bedroom with plaster wall #EFE9E0 over polished pale tile #E4DFD7, and a peach infographic field #FBF5EE carrying sand title bands #EFE0D2 and warm-white cards #FFFDFA, every piece grounded by a real soft contact shadow; lighting system one large soft key from camera left, raking side light across leather grain, piping, top stitching and wood end grain, shadow side filled with a bounce card, never harsh speculars and never contradictory light direction; typography one modern geometric Chinese sans-serif in bold display weights plus a letterspaced Latin eyebrow line, headline 28-44pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, all rendered copy as placeholder text inside 「」 brackets; layout system ribbon section tabs with a two-digit index number, rounded cards at 20-24px radius with a soft drop shadow, pill tags, 1px hairline rules #E0D6C9, one oversized hairline-outlined ghost glyph in the corner of material screens; icon system single-weight thin line icons with one solid warm-amber fill block #EFA53C, check and cross glyphs only; product presentation rules one shared 3/4 anchor angle across screens, identical scale, headboard curve direction and contact-shadow behaviour, upholstery panel layout, piping, edge banding, body thickness profile and leather sheen never altered, grain and stitching always lit from the same side; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership or store badges, no invented certifications, measurements, material origins, foam grades, spring counts or year figures.

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail screen, three stacked diagonal-split cards on a peach infographic field #FBF5EE, each holding one close crop of {product}. Top crop is the softened rounded corner of the rail, grazed from a clean 90-degree side profile so the polish of the radius reads. Middle crop is the upholstered foot board seen from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, echoing the headboard curve. Bottom crop is the thickened raised bed leg photographed from a very low angle looking upward under the side rail, with one slim robot-vacuum disc at the floor as the clearance scale anchor and no measurement digits. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {style_lock}. Raking light from camera left at 4200K on every crop with a bounce card filling the shadow side, shallow depth of field at f/3.2. Each card pairs its crop with a warm-white text half #FFFDFA carrying a label 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #33302C at 18pt and one subline placeholder 「{callout_4}」 at 12pt, hairline rules #E0D6C9, one ribbon section tab with a two-digit index and a label at the top. Detail crops occupy 55-60% of each card. Vertical 2:3 at 4K. Negative: no blurry subject, no over-smoothed plastic texture, no invented clearance height or leg dimensions, no hands, no extra text, no duplicated crops, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing spec screen. {product} photographed at a slight 3/4 angle at eye level as a mid-shot framing the headboard and the upper half, on a seamless cream studio wall #F8F3EC over a matte pale base #E4DFD7. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. Keep the headboard curve, padded panel layout, piping and edge banding, body thickness profile and leather sheen exactly as in the reference. {style_lock}. Soft daylight from camera right at 4600K with a warm bounce, one consistent shadow direction and a real contact shadow. Product occupies 50-60% of the frame, three thin amber #EFA53C dimension leader lines outside the outline with placeholder labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #33302C at 14pt and all measurement digits left blank for post-production, one letterspaced Latin display line plus a sand spec band #EFE0D2 carrying the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33302C at 30pt, one short note line 「{callout_4}」 in #33302C at 13pt, one amber pill button #EFA53C reading 「{callout_5}」 in #FFFDFA at 20pt, and one blank leaning warm-white picture frame #FFFDFA kept empty as a document placeholder. Vertical 2:3 at 2K. Negative: no invented measurements or units, no QR code, no membership or store badge, no invented discount or urgency claim, no certification names or seals, no company name or contact details, no dense body text, no warped straight lines, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 据 13 张详情页切片提炼。品类以图为准：源夹名「轻奢床垫」与图不符，图内为软体皮艺整床（分格软包床头、软包床尾、实木床脚、高箱储物与气压杆、三种结构可选），并非床垫，故 L1 取 家具家纺、L2 取 卧室家具、leaf 定为 美式轻奢皮艺软包高箱储物床；日后若拿到真正的床垫源图，本模版不得复用。仅首片含完整实拍（奶油调实景卧室中一件浅灰米色软包床，灰绿床品、暖黄靠枕、浅橡床头柜、毛绒兔摆件、亮面浅色地砖），第 03 至 13 片多为版式壳与空白图块，故本模版只继承其视觉语法与版式骨架（丝带序号标签、沙色标题带、超大描边空心汉字、暖白圆角卡、单线图标加暖橙实心块），不复制任何具体造型。已剥离：原文案全部字句、拉丁装饰语、加入会员与全店免费标识、二维码、店铺与品牌字样。所有数值与主张（皮料种名与产地、海绵密度与回弹指标、木种产地与树龄、漆面环保等级、防霉防腐、储物容积与分区数、床脚离地高度、尺寸与手工测量公差、使用年限、保修、结构款数）一律以 {selling_point_*} / {callout_*} 占位，不编造认证、检测报告、医院或实验室背书、弹簧数、泡棉等级与承重，凭证镜只留空相框版位，床头分层示意仅限本床可见层。与库内 家具家纺 既有版 yishijianpai-zhenpi-ruanbaochuang（暗胡桃木加墨黑信息场加奶咖细铜的暖调编辑式体系）区隔明确：本版为奶油加蜜桃加暖橙的明亮轻美式体系，全组浅场、无黑底场，使用丝带序号标签与描边空心汉字，leafslug 取 gaoxiang-piyi-ruanbaochuang 以突出高箱储物主线。机位分布：低 3/4 主图、平视 3/4 首屏、高角俯视分屏、正平视实景、90 度俯视、高 45 度俯视、90 度侧面微距、正平视双栏、45 度后侧、90 度侧面三栏、45 度后侧加极低仰视、3/4 平视收口，共 10 类；全景镜 4/12 约 33%，含俯视与仰视各一，微距与特写 4 镜。
